name: Dartmouth AI Club
tagline: Undergraduates who study and build AI.
description: Dartmouth’s undergraduate AI club. Weekly meetings, and talks with the people building AI.

contact.note: The club's own mailbox (on the live site since Nov 6, 2026). It stays when the officers change.

join.note: The club's page on Dartmouth Groups, which takes a Dartmouth login: people join there and get the link to the club's GroupMe there. Each meeting's time and room, and new talks, are posted in the GroupMe. The GroupMe link itself is never on the site.

hero.alt: Dozens of Dartmouth AI Club members crowded around a long conference table with Yann LeCun, smiling into a wide-angle selfie.
hero.caption: The club with Yann LeCun.
hero.caption_source: Club photo from his visit (Oct 29, 2026, during Dartmouth’s AI at 70 conference); the date is on /speakers

about_photo.alt: About fifteen students at long tables, laptops open, watching Ted Li on a screen at the front of the room. A student stands at the lectern beside it.
about_photo.caption: The club with Ted Li, over Zoom.
about_photo.caption_source: Club photo of Ted Li’s talk over Zoom (Charlie Peers, Nov 17, 2026). His talk is on /speakers.
